# Overview

This document describes the methods used to analyse caribou movement data. It is divided into four sections:

1. Summarizing data. Description of caribou movement datasets that were acquired from the Yukon and BC governments.
2. Defining seasons. A priori seasonal and migration date ranges and methods used to define date ranges for individual caribou.
3. Estimating ranges. Methods used to estimate annual and seasonal ranges.
4. Identifying corridors. Methods used to identify and map seasonal migration corridors.
